company_info.description: ITOCHU-SHOKUHIN Co., Ltd. engages in the wholesale of food products and alcoholic beverages in Japan. The company sells processed foods and alcoholic beverages, imported products, health products, and gifts; and develops and sells frozen side dishes and sweets, and cakes. It is also involved in the logistics management, storage, transportation, and distribution merchandising businesses; and provision of goods information services, as well as engages in the retail business. The company was founded in 1886 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. ITOCHU-SHOKUHIN Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of ITOCHU Corporation.
